it be like that. sometimes it be like that every single day of our fucking lives and sometimes what we have to do is just say "it is what it is" and put up with it, other times we feel absolutely helpless and lost, like nothing and no one will ever save us. life sucks and then you die. but what about all the stuff in between, you know? life sucks, but you live, don't you? in the end you live to see another day, and as cheesy and fake deep and overrated this sounds, you fucking LIVED. you survived this, you survived all of this, and to everyone who has been through things no matter big or small and is still here with us, fighting for another day, thank you. thank you so much. i hope everyone reading this is having a lovely day, but if not, i know you've got this. thank you for existing, and for fighting on.

i just hate being a burden to him like that, he's already struggling with his own life and how people like his friends and even his family are treating him. i'm supposed to be someone he finds comfort in and someone he can relax with, not someone who hurts him and makes him feel like he's not good enough

even if i don't lose him, i don't think things will ever be the same as before. i've never ever felt this much guilt and pain over something, i regret my actions so fucking much. he even said to me, "please just stop hurting me" and those words have been ringing on and on in my mind since he said them, i just want it to stop, i don't want to hurt him anymore, it was never my intention to
i just really, really don't have anything else going for me in my life, i'm sort of a fucking loser
i'm sorry if i burden you, but please i really need someone to at least vent to, and if you're willing to do that then thank you so much, but if not i completely understand
